conversation.text: Dwaine, Honest question, and I ask every driver this: if the truck stopped tomorrow, how long before your family would feel it? A month? Less?
conversation.label: D3 who feels it first (beneficiary)

conversation.text: Dwaine, I'll be straight about why I do this. Drivers are the backbone of this country and yall get forgotten. Crazy schedules, always working, and nobody ever sits down with you to make sure the people at home are covered if you can't be. That's the whole reason I only work with CDL holders. Still want me to look at yours?
conversation.label: D4 why I do this

conversation.text: Morning Dwaine. Did my texts get buried, or is this just bad timing right now? Either one's fine, just tell me which.
conversation.label: D5 buried or bad timing

conversation.text: Dwaine, one thing that holds a lot of drivers back: blood pressure meds, sleep apnea, a few extra pounds. With the carriers I use for drivers, none of that is an automatic no. Is health part of what's had you on the fence?
conversation.label: D7 health objection

conversation.text: Dwaine, the part most owner ops have never been told: the plan I set drivers up with has living benefits. If you get sick or hurt and can't drive, it pays you while you're alive, not just your family after. The truck note and the house note don't stop just because you did. Even if you've already got a policy, does yours do that?
conversation.label: D9 living benefits (works even if they already have a policy)

conversation.text: Dwaine, have you given up on this? No hard feelings if so. I just keep thinking you filled that form out for your family, not for me, and I don't like leaving a driver hanging.
conversation.label: D11 given up?

conversation.text: Dwaine, the IUL you asked about does two jobs. It protects your family if something happens to you, and it builds cash you can pull as tax free income in retirement, with downside protection when the market drops. Most drivers have nothing doing that second job. I can show you how it works in 10 minutes. Want a spot this week?
conversation.label: D14 the IUL: protection now, tax free income later
